summary: We developed an interactive dashboard to help undergraduate students with little to no background knowledge about aerospace systems or aerospace protocols. It allows for users to not have to investigate different research papers from the NASA database and instead refer them to the direct information as well as the direct source. The dashboard also provides a simulation tab of different variations of flames in different spatial conditions.
details: Our project is to help spread awareness about overall fire safety practices when going out of the orbit. Our website uses Physical Sciences Informatics (PSI) database information from NASA to provide information about factors that can affect the conditions of flames when in and out of orbit in different spatial locations. We used Google Gemini AI to format the dashboard itself and include a interactive AI chatbot in the dashboard itself. The dashboard provides sources from the PSI database, a tab about why fire safety matters, a sandbox simulation to see how the flame of a rocket located in different spatial conditions is shaped, a prevention and response tab that provides insight to how to better prepare for a potential fire and how to put it out, and a guided case study tab that shows some quiz questions about fire safety for users to engage and test their knowledge.
